primary_target: Independent component calibration predicts sealed held-out physical compositions within a preregistered absolute tolerance and joint uncertainty
secondary_target: A measured coarse-equivalent pair is distinguishable by the declared joint complex observer on sealed records

source_and_ports.initial_domain: One conducted signal path,two physical binary insert/bypass blocks and a common calibrated reference; only enumerated available compositions
source_and_ports.composition: Loaded two-port composition unless matched scalar multiplication is independently justified
source_and_ports.readout: Raw coherent IQ,reference and quality/power/controller records; joint real-vector representation for inference
source_and_ports.physical_time: Acquisition timestamps and independently characterized RF timing only; no clock inferred from mathematical history or attenuation index

analysis_gates.prediction: One calibration-frozen common parameter vector; no held-out or per-setting nuisance refit
analysis_gates.uncertainty: Joint measurement/calibration covariance with shared-reference and cross-configuration terms; frozen treatment of singular ranges
analysis_gates.acceptance: Simultaneous confidence upper bound below an absolute engineering tolerance plus preregistered predictive coverage; non-rejection alone is insufficient
analysis_gates.contrast: Mixed contrast and AB/BA order contrast are distinct; neither alone is the primary acceptance statistic
analysis_gates.observer: Coarse equivalence and held-out joint separation must both pass; labels are scoring metadata,not signal inputs
analysis_gates.intermediate: Use held-out intermediate settings/frequencies/transients where endpoint-equivalent models disagree; do not identify a Hamiltonian from endpoints

preregistration_requirements: verified inventory and instrument manuals/port limits
safe source-to-receiver link budget and numeric margin
physical configuration/termination/reference map and feasible context list
component,fixture and receiver calibration with digests
frozen model/code/parameter policy and planned held-out predictions
